title: Alex Honnold on Human Performance (part 2) – Climbing and Entrepreneurship

reader_summary.headline: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi, and welcome to the A16Z podcast. I'm Doss, and this is part two of our two-part series on human performance with rock climber Alex Honnold. In part one, we talked to Alex about the limits of human potential in climbing and other sports.

key_points.text: I'm Doss, and this is part two of our two-part series on human performance with rock climber Alex Honnold.
key_points.evidence_quote: I'm Doss, and this is part two of our two-part series on human performance with rock climber Alex Honnold, who first became famous with his free solo climb of El Cap and Yosemite, a feat captured in the award-winning documentary Free Solo.

key_points.text: In part one, we talked to Alex about the limits of human potential in climbing and other sports.
key_points.evidence_quote: In part one, we talked to Alex about the limits of human potential in climbing and other sports, and how we push those limits through technology and training.

key_points.text: In this episode, recorded at our 16Z Innovation Summit last year.
key_points.evidence_quote: In this episode, recorded at our 16Z Innovation Summit last year, Alex talks to A16Z general partner and fellow avid climber Peter Levine about how he prepared for his free solo, including some things that the film didn't show.

key_points.text: Climbing's the topic, but the conversation holds parallels and lessons for entrepreneurs and anyone else who's undertaking something that's never been done before.
key_points.evidence_quote: Climbing's the topic, but the conversation holds parallels and lessons for entrepreneurs and anyone else who's undertaking something that's never been done before.
